title: Global generation gives a cover by nonvanishing loci
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module], and suppose $\mathcal L$ is generated by a family of global sections [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. For each global section $s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L)$ let $X_s=\{x\in X:s_x\notin\mathfrak m_x(\mathcal L)_x\}$ be its nonvanishing locus [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Then $X=\bigcup_{s\in\Gamma(X,\mathcal L)}X_s$.

source.place: Modules, Definition 01AM, Lemma 01CY, and Sheaves Lemma 0H7H(2)

proof.text: Fix x in X and suppose that every global section has germ in P = m_x L_x. Let sigma be a generating family, so sigma.pi : free sigma.I -> L is an epimorphism by [def-weil-pbc-generating-sections]. Form the quotient map q : L_x -> L_x/P and the morphism f : L -> skyscraper_x(L_x/P) sending a section t on U containing x to q(t_x), and to the unique zero section when x is not in U. The already proved source-library construction toSkyscraper in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.FlatPullbackStalk gives precisely this morphism; only its sectionwise definition is used, not an unproved adjunction theorem.

For each generating compatible global section sigma.s i, its germ on any open U containing x equals the germ of its value on the terminal open, by sections_property and germ_res_apply. This germ belongs to P by the supposition, so q kills it. Therefore sectionsMap f (sigma.s i) is the zero compatible section. Apply freeHomEquiv injectivity to conclude sigma.pi composed with f is zero, using freeHomEquiv_comp_apply and its inverse identity. This argument does not require the indexing family to be finite.

Cancel the epimorphism sigma.pi to get f = 0. Every stalk element t has a representative on some neighbourhood U of x. Evaluating f = 0 on that representative and then at x shows q(t) = 0. The quotient criterion gives t in P for every t in L_x.

Use [lem-weil-pbc-invertible-stalk-linear-equiv] to choose a linear equivalence e : L_x -> O_{X,x}. In particular e inverse of 1 belongs to P. Under e the image of P = m_x times the whole stalk is m_x: map_smul, surjectivity of e, and m_x times the whole ring = m_x prove this. Thus 1 belongs to m_x, contradicting that the maximal ideal of the local ring is proper. Hence some global section is nonvanishing at x. Since x was arbitrary, set membership in the indexed union proves the required equality with X.

split_report.summary: Split the global-generation consequence of Stacks 01AM/01CY and 0H7H(2). For an arbitrary point, invertibility supplies a local basis, and local surjectivity of the generating family expresses that basis as a finite combination of global sections; reduction modulo the maximal ideal forces one section to have nonzero residue, so its nonvanishing locus contains the point. No new nodes were needed.
